claim: Aurora added a second DB cluster storage configuration, Aurora I/O-Optimized, on May 11, 2023: you pay only for the usage and storage of your DB clusters, with no additional charges for read and write I/O operations.
question: What did Aurora add in May 2023 and how are I/O operations charged with it?

values.display: no additional charges for read and write I/O operations
values.spoken: no additional charges for read and write I/O operations

qualifiers.condition: the other configuration is Aurora Standard

note: d27-092. Older exam material knows only the pay-per-I/O model, now called Aurora Standard.
